text:
This looks like a large mixing bowl, roughly 28 cm across at the rim. The food covers an area about 13 cm wide.

The main item is white cubes and chunks, most likely tofu. Some of the pieces on top look like shaved or flaked white cheese, possibly parmesan, which I've listed separately. The cubes are about 1.5-2 cm. The pile is roughly 13 x 11 cm and 4 cm high. That is about 200 cm³ with gaps between the pieces, so around 170 g of tofu.

The flakes on top are a small amount, about 25 g.

Red onion slivers are about 15 g, and shredded carrot is about 10 g.
